LanguageData.TM_Bridge_SniperArmorFracture.label: armor fracture
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_SniperArmorFracture.descriptio: Fire one ordinary bullet. A hit opens a breach for your squad for six seconds, reducing effective armor by 10, 15 or 20 percentage points by rank. Each hit stacks and expires separately. Costs 20 stamina. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
